summary: the side of a cubic box for a number of particles of a given volume at a given volume fraction

inputs.name: particle_count
inputs.meaning: how many particles the box holds

inputs.name: particle_volume
inputs.meaning: the volume of one particle, in the engine's own units

inputs.name: volume_fraction
inputs.meaning: the fraction of the box the particles fill, above zero and below one

outputs.name: box_length
outputs.meaning: the side of the cubic box

outputs.name: box_volume
outputs.meaning: the box's volume, particle_count times particle_volume over volume_fraction

validity: identical particles in a cubic box; the volume fraction above zero and below one

source.citation: a definition: the volume fraction; E. R. Cohen et al., Quantities, Units and Symbols in Physical Chemistry, IUPAC Green Book, 3rd ed. (RSC Publishing, 2007; 2nd printing 2008) (read 2026-11-17, https://iupac.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/IUPAC-GB3-2012-2ndPrinting-PDFsearchable.pdf; meta_agent/inbox/materials/20261117-iupac-green-book-2007)
source.locus: Section 2.10, p. 48: phi_B = V_B / sum_i V_i; note 9 asks that the definition be spelled out in accurate work: here the particles' total volume over the box's volume, the box's volume including the space between the particles

note: v1 with the definition it rests on named where it is defined, found by search, and spelled out as the source asks; the code and the cases are v1's.
